answers.core: This is a modification to existing core functionality
answers.workaround:
This can be imperfectly worked around by creating a property track for `AudioStreamPlayer.playing` (with discrete interpolation).  The waveform will appear in the animation timeline, and the sound will play in the editor.  However, if `playing` is keyframed at the start of the animation, the sound will also play whenever the animation is `stop()`ped!

![Screenshot_20230711_190258](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/assets/441188/a4a3049a-e076-4165-be0c-dcc2a1263ff0)

Another workaround mechanism is to use a "call method track" on the `play` method of the `AudioStreamPlayer`.  However in this case, the audio is neither previewed nor played back in the editor.

![Screenshot_20230711_143111](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/assets/441188/651e0566-5c65-4bf6-9428-70dc3062a822)
